data.title: Beta Test II Ending Notice
data.data:
Dear Endministrator:

Arknights: Endfield Beta Test II will conclude on Dec. 29, 2025 at 1:00 AM (UTC-5). At that time, the game servers for this test will be shut down, and you will no longer be able to log into the game.

During the test period, we have received a great deal of feedback and suggestions through official community channels, surveys, and customer support. We sincerely thank everyone for participating in the test and actively providing your input. The project team will continue to refine the game and optimize the gaming experience, with more new content already in development.

For further game updates, please follow our official community and social media accounts. Thank you again for your continued interest and support for Arknights: Endfield, Endministrator!


﻿Arknights: Endfield Team
